Goal: Maximize lint pass rate across the codebase by iteratively fixing lint violations within a bounded budget
Scope: All source files matched by the project lint configuration (e.g., src/**/*.{ts,js,py}); excludes auto-generated files and vendored dependencies
Metric: lint_pass_rate = (passing_files / total_files) * 100  — measured as a percentage rounded to two decimal places after each iteration

Verify.protocol: After each fix attempt, re-run the lint tool against the full file set; parse its exit code and violation count; compute lint_pass_rate; assert current_rate > previous_rate before accepting the iteration as progress
Verify.failure_action: Revert the attempted fix, log the delta as 0, and count the iteration as consumed

Guard.name: invariant_guard
invariants: lint_pass_rate must be non-decreasing across accepted iterations (monotonic improvement)
No iteration may introduce new lint violations in files that were previously clean
No source file may be deleted or have its public API signature changed as a side-effect of a lint fix
If lint_pass_rate stalls (delta = 0) for 2 consecutive iterations, the guard raises STALL and halts early
Guard.violation_action: Hard-stop the loop, restore last known-good state, and emit a GUARD_VIOLATION record in the run log

Iterations.early_stop_condition: lint_pass_rate reaches 100% OR invariant_guard raises STALL OR GUARD_VIOLATION

iteration_schema.files_targeted: list of file paths attempted this iteration
